title: Upper bound on the construction cost
statement: For natural numbers $k,t,n$ with $k>0$ and $n\le 2t+1$, and for $\ell,r\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define $C=(1+nk)+(1+r_0(k+1))+(n+r_0)k+(1+\ell_0(k+1))$, where $r_0$ and $\ell_0$ are $1$ when $r$ and $\ell$ are true and $0$ otherwise. Then $C\le (4t+7)k+4$.
